1.why: I dislike maths and believe I am bad at it, so I strongly disagree this statement about being good at mathematics.

3.why: I find mathematics courses extremely difficult and cannot learn well from them so I strongly disagree with this statement.

4.why: I am not confident about future math courses since I dislike the subject but might pass if forced to attend classes.

5.why: The content in math courses is hard for me to understand and I struggle with abstract concepts so I strongly disagree.

6.why: Getting an A requires effort I am willing to put in but I worry about performance so I moderately agree.

7.why: I can do basic operations but complex problems overwhelm me so I feel neutral about doing math in a course.
